definitions.explanation: How easy or convenient something is to use. Refers to the practical experience of using a tool, product, or system. Can be either positive or negative.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{使|つか}い{勝手|がって}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{使|つか}い{勝手|がって}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: The design is nice, but it's not easy to use.

examples.japanese: {使|つか}い{勝手|がって}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重視|じゅうし}して→重視する：26832_juushisuru⟧⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{台所|だいどころ}→台所：01021_daidokoro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|らく}になる→楽になる：26083_rakuninaru⟧。
examples.english: A kitchen designed with usability in mind makes daily cooking easier.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{使|つか}い→使い：25633_tsukai⟧ (using, from ⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧) and ⟦{勝手|かって}→勝手：03021_katte⟧ (convenience, one's own way). The ⟦{勝手|かって}→勝手：03021_katte⟧ becomes がって due to rendaku (sequential voicing).

Almost always used with ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (easy to use) or ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (hard to use). A practical, everyday word for evaluating products, tools, and interfaces.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{操作性|そうさせい}→操作性：18792_sousasei⟧ is more technical (operability)
- ⟦{利便性|りべんせい}→利便性：10681_ribensei⟧ is more formal (convenience)
- ⟦{使|つか}いやすさ→使いやすさ：30369_tsukaiyasusa⟧ is a simpler way to say 'ease of use'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {使|つか}い{勝手|がって}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (easy to use)
- {使|つか}い{勝手|がって}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (hard to use)
- {使|つか}い{勝手|がって}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}する→改善する：26828_kaizensuru⟧ (to improve usability)
- {使|つか}い{勝手|がって}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧ (a handy tool)
